text: There is a water leak in Building C that has been running all morning. It is pooling near the server room door.
I want to report that one of our suppliers may not meet our sustainability policy. They told me their factory dumps waste into the river.
The accessible entrance near the main building has been blocked for two days. A wheelchair user in my team had to go round the back.
The air conditioning is running overnight in an empty office.
Thanks to whoever fixed the recycling bins on level 2, they look great now!
